data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Mechanically enforce 9-leaf invariant against draft-6's canonical leaf-name set at import/test time. Add test in test_errors.py (or test_dso_id_label_writers.py): import canonical leaf-name set from draft-6 module (e.g., REPAIR_PROPERTY_LEAVES or equivalent symbol); assert _AUTHORIZED_DSO_ID_LABEL_WRITERS ∪ UNAUTHORIZED_LEAVES == draft_6_canonical_set AND subsets are disjoint and total. Replaces docstring-only enumeration with mechanical drift detection — first test run after draft-6 leaf add/rename catches it. Required because dso-id is load-bearing identity primitive; docstring drift is silent (cross_task_interference).
